test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. All grills are ovens.

II. Some tandoors are grills.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some tandoors are oven.

II. All ovens are tandoor.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f34eb347a6de60aac96da7dfb861477a612a541a60ed7ca54144f66b22374090.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some tandoors are oven. → Follows (As, All grills are ovens and Some tandoors are grills → Some tandoors are oven is definitely follow)

II. All ovens are tandoor. → Do not follow (As, All grills are ovens and Some tandoors are grills → Some ovens are tandoor, All ovens are tandoor is possible but not definitely follow )

Hence, **Only conclusion I follows**.
